build_sentence_transformer_model: build a sentence transformer model using FastSentenceTransformer.from_pretrained with 16-bit loading and torch.compile optimization
create_peft_lora_model: create a LoRA PEFT model on a SentenceTransformer with r=16 target_modules query key value dense and lora_alpha=16
save_model_gguf: save a SentenceTransformer model to GGUF format with fast_quantized quantization method and custom tokenizer
push_model_hf_hub_gguf: push a SentenceTransformer model to Hugging Face Hub as GGUF with q4_k_m quantization and private repo
save_model_torchao: save a SentenceTransformer model with TorchAO quantization and push to Hugging Face Hub
